c5.why: The routing asked for successors applying arithmetic CS to REAL PLACES or volumes, and typed the deliverable DECIDABLE-HERE / NEEDS-SPECIALIST-CONFIRMED / literature-empty. NONE of those three is right. The real-places extension EXISTS and is named: Lee-Park, 'Arithmetic Chern-Simons theory with real places', arXiv:1905.13610. So C5 is NOT literature-empty. But B1088's sharpened question is whether any arithmetic-CS paper carries a VOLUME or REGULATOR term -- since the object's CS is 0 by amphichirality, the volume term is the whole question -- and abstract-level search did not establish that, so it is not DECIDABLE-HERE either. It is also not NEEDS-SPECIALIST: B8103's own thesis is that a specialist gate has a date, and this is a paper to read, not an expert to find.

differentiators.not_claimed: We never embed the gravitational SL(2,C) into the same exceptional algebra as the internal symmetry -- the gravity sector here is a separate, parameter-free 2+1 theory (B8099-B8113) -- and our landing is on E6, not E8, so Theorem 1.3's hypotheses are not our setup twice over. More importantly we make NO CLAIM THAT THE OBJECT SUPPLIES CHIRALITY: B713/B760 prove it does not, B1028 prices it as a declared input, and B582 constructs it only under an inserted closing. THE PROPERTY DISTLER-GARIBALDI PROVED UNATTAINABLE IS THE ONE WE INDEPENDENTLY BANK AS A NEGATIVE. Their no-go kills a hypothesis we decline to assume.
differentiators.rival: Lisi's E8 unification, and the Distler-Garibaldi no-go
differentiators.what_they_did: Lisi (arXiv:0711.0770) proposed embedding gravity and the Standard Model in a single real form of E8. Distler-Garibaldi (arXiv:0905.2658; Comm. Math. Phys. 298 (2010) 419) proved this cannot work. THEOREM 1.3, verbatim: 'There are no ToE subgroups in (the transfer of) the complex E8 nor in any real form of E8.' A ToE subgroup must satisfy (ToE1) a compact G centralizing SL(2,C), (ToE2) no irreps m(x)n with m+n>4, and (ToE3) that V_{2,1} be a COMPLEX representation of G -- i.e. admitting no antilinear J with J^4 = 1 commuting with the action. ToE3 IS CHIRALITY. The obstruction is that the centralizer of any admissible SL(2,C) forces a self-conjugate structure, so the theory is non-chiral.

differentiators.not_claimed: We do not derive internal charges from a division-algebra ideal structure, and we make no generation-counting claim from ideals. Where our object meets the octonions it is through the CUBIC DETERMINANT of J_3(O) (B884), used as an INVARIANT of a variety, not as a state space; no fermion is ever an element of an algebra here.
differentiators.what_they_did: Furey's thesis 'Standard model physics from an algebra?' (arXiv:1611.09182) derives Standard Model representation content from R(x)C(x)H(x)O acting on itself: C(x)H carries the Lorentzian degrees of freedom including spin and chirality, C(x)O supplies colour and weak isospin, and minimal left ideals of the Dixon algebra C(x)H(x)O mirror one generation of quarks and leptons.

differentiators.not_claimed: We produce NO action functional whose asymptotic expansion yields a Lagrangian, and NO prediction of any coupling, mass or mixing angle. Gate 5 forbids any measured value entering a claim, and Tier 2 -- one sealed dimensionless ratio -- is explicitly NOT DONE with no live candidate. Where they predict numbers, we state a structural result and price the inputs.
differentiators.what_they_did: Chamseddine-Connes-Marcolli, 'Gravity and the standard model with neutrino mixing' (arXiv:hep-th/0610241; Adv. Theor. Math. Phys. 11 (2007) 991-1089), build an almost-commutative spectral triple whose SPECTRAL ACTION reproduces the Standard Model Lagrangian minimally coupled to gravity, with unification carried by the symplectic unitary group in Hilbert space.

differentiators.not_claimed: We construct no CS functional on a space of Galois representations and no TQFT over Spec O_K. Our arithmetic is the FIELD OF DEFINITION of one specific hyperbolic 3-manifold's invariants, which is a different use of the same words. The analogy is suggestive and is registered as unproved.
differentiators.rival: Arithmetic topology and arithmetic Chern-Simons theory
differentiators.what_they_did: Kim, 'Arithmetic Chern-Simons Theory I' (arXiv:1510.05818), applies Dijkgraaf-Witten 2+1 TQFT to arithmetic curves -- spectra of rings of integers -- defining classical CS functionals on spaces of GALOIS REPRESENTATIONS. Continued in ACS II (arXiv:1609.03012) and in abelian ACS with arithmetic linking numbers (arXiv:1706.03336). Lee-Park, 'Arithmetic Chern-Simons theory with real places' (arXiv:1905.13610), extends the construction to real places.

differentiators.not_claimed: We claim no new 3d-3d duality. B262's T[4_1] is IMPORTED, not derived, and B8099 records that the corpus attaches TWO DIFFERENT 3d theories to the same manifold -- an ambiguity we flag rather than resolve. Our 2+1 line computes a one-loop factor and a torsion ratio for a fixed manifold; it does not assert a correspondence.
differentiators.what_they_did: Dimofte-Gaiotto-Gukov, '3-Manifolds and 3d Indices' (arXiv:1112.5179; Adv. Theor. Math. Phys. 17 (2013) 975-1076), identify the 3d N=2 theories T_M of M5-branes wrapped on a 3-manifold and show their supersymmetric index is a new topological invariant equivalent to non-holomorphic SL(2,C) Chern-Simons theory on M -- the figure-eight complement being the standard worked example.

verdict: FIVE VERIFIED DIFFERENTIATORS FOR THE PAPER, AND C5 IS ONE FETCH AWAY RATHER THAN FENCED. Every citation was fetched or searched this date, not recalled. THE SHARPEST FINDING IS THE FIRST: Distler-Garibaldi's Theorem 1.3 rules out any ToE subgroup in complex E8 or any real form, and the obstruction (ToE3) IS CHIRALITY -- the centralizer of any admissible SL(2,C) forces a self-conjugate structure. THAT IS THE PROPERTY THIS PROGRAMME INDEPENDENTLY BANKS AS A NEGATIVE (B713/B760 the object does not supply chirality; B1028 prices it as a declared input), so the most-cited refutation in this neighbourhood kills a hypothesis we decline to assume -- and it does not even apply, since we never embed the gravitational SL(2,C) in the internal algebra and land on E6 rather than E8. AND C5 IS RE-TYPED: not literature-empty (Lee-Park arXiv:1905.13610 treats real places), not decidable-here (whether it carries a volume/regulator term needs the full text), not needs-specialist (it is a paper to read). NEEDS-READING, one fetch away.
